steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: When Mr. Freeze's HP drops below 35% for the first time, he inflicts [Frozen] on nearby enemies for 1s, then restores 20% of his Max HP over 5s.

steps.label: 5★ White
steps.text: When Mr. Freeze's HP drops below 35% for the first time, he inflicts [Frozen] on nearby enemies for 1.5s, then restores 35% of his Max HP over 5s.

steps.label: 5★ Purple
steps.text: When Mr. Freeze's HP drops below 35% for the first time, he inflicts [Frozen] on nearby enemies for 2s, then restores 55% of his Max HP over 5s.

steps.label: 5★ Red
steps.text: When Mr. Freeze's HP drops below 35% for the first time, he inflicts [Frozen] on nearby enemies for 3s, then restores 80% of his Max HP over 5s.

steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: When the wearer is hit by an enemy basic attack, there is a 50% base chance to restore HP equal to 1.2% of lost HP.

steps.label: 5★ Blue
steps.text: When the wearer is hit by an enemy basic attack, there is a 50% base chance to restore HP equal to 2.5% of lost HP.

steps.label: 5★ Yellow
steps.text: When the wearer is hit by an enemy basic attack, there is a 50% base chance to restore HP equal to 4% of lost HP.

guide.text: Mr. Freeze's signature gear. When hit by basic attacks, he has a chance to recover lost HP. When his HP drops below a certain threshold, he inflicts [Frozen] on nearby enemies while continuously restoring HP.
